labels.name: Returns & refunds
labels.definition: Requests to return, exchange, or obtain a refund for an item, including return authorization and refund allocation. Do not infer a return from a fit or defect complaint alone.

labels.name: Delivery & tracking
labels.definition: Dispatch, parcel location, delivery timing, carrier handoff, missing or misdelivered parcels. Delivery charges belong to shipping_fees.

labels.name: Size & fit
labels.definition: Dimensions, body measurements, sizing, clearance, and suitability of physical fit. Product damage alone is not a fit issue.

labels.name: Receipts & invoices
labels.definition: Copies, formats, names, itemization, and corrections on purchase documents. U.S. itemized and gift receipts; no VAT-invoice assumptions.

labels.name: Product defects
labels.definition: An explicitly stated actual fault, damage, contamination, or safety defect. A hypothetical warranty question alone is not a defect report.

labels.name: Shipping fees
labels.definition: Postage, handling, shipping thresholds, weight charges, and delivery surcharges. A carrier-location question is delivery_tracking.

labels.name: Promotions
labels.definition: Coupons, advertised offers, campaign eligibility, stacking, and promotional gifts. A purchase followed by a price drop belongs to price_adjustments.

labels.name: Price adjustments
labels.definition: Requests and eligibility for credit because a price fell after purchase, including competitor price protection questions. Do not assume the business actually offers the requested policy.

labels.name: Payments
labels.definition: Checkout payment methods, authorizations, payment failures, duplicate charges, and saved payment instruments. Refund destination as part of a return alone stays returns_refunds.

labels.name: Order changes
labels.definition: Edits or cancellations to an unfulfilled purchase or upcoming recurring order. A return of an already received item is returns_refunds.

labels.name: Stock & availability
labels.definition: Availability, backorders, restock alerts, discontinuation, and reserving inventory. Questions about product characteristics belong to product_information.

labels.name: Product information
labels.definition: Materials, ingredients, features, operation, care, and compatibility not specifically about physical fit. Tag the requested information rather than every mentioned object.

labels.name: Warranty & repairs
labels.definition: Coverage, repair authorization, service status, maintenance effects, and paid servicing. Do not infer a repair request merely because a product is broken.

labels.name: Account & access
labels.definition: Login, authentication, profile privacy, account recovery, account deletion, and profile preferences. Payment-card management stays payments.

labels.name: Loyalty & rewards
labels.definition: Points, membership status, loyalty accrual, redemption, transfers, and program benefits. Generic promotion questions stay promotions.

labels.name: Reviews & feedback
labels.definition: Publishing, editing, moderation, visibility, attribution, and media for product reviews. A private complaint about a defect alone is not a review request.

labels.name: Other
labels.definition: Requests outside the other sixteen topics, including human handoff, support hours, unrelated services, medical questions, and small talk. Exclusive fallback; never combine with a recognized topic.
